blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport and a flight to Calama, followed by a transfer to San Pedro de Atacama. After arrival, it is best to allow time to acclimatize to the altitude, dry air and strong sun.

In the evening, you can take a group astronomical tour. The group travels outside the village, where there is very little light from the town. Through professional telescopes, you can see the Moon, planets, star clusters and other objects, while an English-speaking guide tells you about the desert's night sky.

Astronomical tour price: **USD 150 per person**. The tour does not operate when the Moon is bright or during a full moon.
